## Observed behavior

Describe the defect and the exact command/API surface involved.

## Expected behavior

Describe the deterministic behavior you expected.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest reproducible repository state or fixture, exact SpecGrain version/commit, operating system, Python version, and commands. Remove secrets and sensitive data.

## Evidence

Include relevant output, issue codes, digests/revisions, or failing tests. Do not post vulnerability exploit details here; follow `SECURITY.md`.
